name: EPIC 201499054
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 14, 10.1 solar radii and 0.88 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201499054 (K2 campaign 14): PARAM radius (solar radii) 10.132276 (16th-84th percentiles 9.899309-10.594933), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201499054 (K2 campaign 14): PARAM mass (solar masses) 0.880444 (16th-84th percentiles 0.832816-0.953714), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201499054: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4794.934 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201499054 (K2 campaign 14): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 3234.84375 (16th-84th percentiles 3181.757812-3300.429688), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.12 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the colour routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 3,235 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 14, give 0.88 solar masses and 10.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,795 K at its surface.
